segments.title: ONE park has 99 kinds of BATS
segments.say: One park in Bolivia has ninety-nine kinds of bats.

segments.title: 68% of Bolivia's bats
segments.say: That's sixty-eight percent of all the bat species known in Bolivia, in one park.

segments.title: Fruit, nectar and more
segments.say: Some eat fruit. Some drink nectar from flowers. Others catch insects.

segments.title: 7 new to Bolivia
segments.say: Seven species had never been recorded in Bolivia before.

segments.title: One may be NEW to science
segments.sub: Source: **ZooKeys** study, via Pensoft and WCS
segments.say: And one big-eared bat may be a species nobody has named yet.
Follow for Weird Animal number 23 tomorrow.
